errors.text_span: Някои от стълбовете са групирани в няколко различни цвята, което показва площите на всяка държава за всеки отделен годишен период.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly and confusingly describes the chart's structure. The chart is a grouped bar chart where for each year (a category on the x-axis), there is a group of bars representing different countries. The description implies that only some bars are grouped, which is not the case.

In the sentence describing the year 2013, the lowest value (Argentina) is stated to be around 260. Visually, this value is much lower, approximately 220-230 thousand hectares. 260 is a significant overestimation.

errors.text_span: През 2022 г. най-високата стойност е около 960, а най-ниската е около 260.
errors.evidence: Both values reported for 2022 are incorrect and misleading. The highest value (Spain) has visibly decreased from 2013 and is closer to 950, not 960. The lowest value (Argentina) has also decreased and is just above 200 (approx. 210); stating it is 260 is a major overestimation. By repeating the same numbers as for 2013, the description incorrectly implies that the values have not changed.
